creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen with a_32xp8grzh: a devenv's daemon directory held about 30 window-release-*.sock files from windows long gone. Remove a window's socket path when the window leaves, or sweep paths nothing listens on at daemon start, keeping any that belong to a current window. Raised by factory run muster-1119-iris while building a_32xp8grzh.
title: Stale window-release-*.sock paths pile up in an SSH machine's daemon directory
